title: Screening of Oxidative Stress-related Biomarkers and Antioxidant Drugs for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Based on Bioinformatics and Molecular Docking.
authors: Chen, Lanhui; Li, Tian; Xu, Jialiang; Liao, Siqi; Xu, Haocheng; Li, Kun; Ivanova, Deyana; Si, Yuewen; Zhang, Xin; Zhang, Jianning; Li, Fangfang; Chen, Xuemei; Wang, Yingxiong; Xie, Biao; Shi, Dan; Wang, Meijiao
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和分子对接筛选PCOS氧化应激相关生物标志物及抗氧化药物，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a prevalent endocrine and metabolic disorder affecting women of reproductive age. Oxidative stress (OS) is suggested to play a significant role in the development of PCOS. Using antioxidants to reduce OS and maintain a healthy balance in the body could be a novel treatment approach for PCOS. This study analyzed transcriptome data from the Gene Expression Omnibus database, focusing on genes associated with OS. By implementing two machine learning algorithms, three OS-related biomarkers-HMOX1, MMP9, and KLF2-were successfully identified. To evaluate the diagnostic potential of these biomarkers, a Logistic regression model was employed. Additionally, granulosa cells were collected from healthy individuals and infertile women with PCOS, and the reliability of HMOX1, MMP9, and KLF2 was verified by quantitative real-time PCR experiments. Furthermore, small molecule drugs targeting proteins encoded by genes HMOX1 and MMP9 were predicted through the Drug Signature Database. Molecular docking of drugs to proteins identified two antioxidants, butein and demethoxycurcumin, as potential candidates for PCOS therapy.
abstract_zh: 多囊卵巢综合征（polycystic ovary syndrome, PCOS）是一种影响育龄女性的常见内分泌代谢性疾病。氧化应激（oxidative stress, OS）被认为在PCOS的发生发展中发挥重要作用。利用抗氧化剂减轻OS并维持机体健康平衡，可能成为PCOS的一种新型治疗策略。本研究分析了来自Gene Expression Omnibus数据库的转录组数据，重点关注与OS相关的基因。通过应用两种机器学习算法，成功识别出三个与OS相关的生物标志物——HMOX1、MMP9和KLF2。为评估这些生物标志物的诊断潜力，采用了Logistic回归模型。此外，从健康个体和患有PCOS的不孕女性中收集颗粒细胞，并通过实时定量PCR实验验证了HMOX1、MMP9和KLF2的可靠性。进一步地，通过药物签名数据库（Drug Signature Database）预测了靶向HMOX1和MMP9基因编码蛋白的小分子药物。药物与蛋白的分子对接（molecular docking）鉴定出两种抗氧化剂——butein和demethoxycurcumin，作为PCOS治疗的潜在候选药物。
